scope: Local 5207 scan sensitivity experiment; no A7R IV/III/II curve is relabelled as an A7R V measurement

sources.authors: Grigory Solomatov and Derya Akkaynak, ICCP 2023
sources.method: DNG colour matrices and autoencoder; no direct camera measurement
sources.redistribution: not reviewed; numeric file retained on private external volume

units: Relative responses, not absolute QE. The experiment uses the effective energy-response forward-model convention. Lens inclusion, per-photon calibration, uncertainty and FWHM are not established by the source header.
processing: Linearly interpolate nonnegative source values only within provided coverage; peak-normalize each camera channel. Shared primary band 400-700 nm; 391-730 nm used for the separate A7R IV coverage control. No invented prediction tails.
rights: Public source metadata only. Source curves, private target and film-derived outputs stay on external storage; no publication permission inferred.
